---
title: "References"
page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Explore the references associated with the AHEAD indicators. Use the search box and column filters to find publications, guidelines and other resources.

```{r}
invisible(
  suppressWarnings(
    suppressMessages({
      library(data.table)
      library(rjson)
      library(reactable)
      library(htmltools)
    })
  )
)

references_dir <- "../references/"

fls <- list.files(
  references_dir,
  full.names = TRUE,
  pattern = "\\.json$"
)

references_dt <- vector("list", length(fls))

for (i in seq_along(fls)) {

  json_data <- fls[i] |>
    readLines(warn = FALSE) |>
    paste(collapse = "") |>
    fromJSON()

  json_data$Indicator <- paste(
    json_data$Indicator,
    collapse = ", "
  )

  references_dt[[i]] <- json_data
}

references_dt <- rbindlist(
  references_dt,
  idcol = "id",
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

reactable(
  references_dt,

  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  striped = FALSE,

  fullWidth = TRUE,
  compact = FALSE,

  defaultPageSize = 15,
  pageSizeOptions = c(10, 15, 25, 50),
  paginationType = "jump",

  defaultColDef = colDef(
    resizable = TRUE,
    minWidth = 150,

    headerStyle = list(
      background = "#f4f2ff",
      color = "#30256f",
      fontWeight = "700",
      borderBottom = "3px solid #5544cc",
      padding = "12px"
    ),

    style = list(
      padding = "12px",
      whiteSpace = "normal",
      lineHeight = "1.45",
      verticalAlign = "top"
    )
  ),

  columns = list(

    id = colDef(
      name = "ID",
      width = 70,
      minWidth = 70,
      align = "center",
      sticky = "left",

      headerStyle = list(
        background = "#5544cc",
        color = "white",
        fontWeight = "700",
        borderBottom = "3px solid #5544cc"
      ),

      style = list(
        background = "white",
        color = "#5544cc",
        fontWeight = "700"
      )
    ),

    Indicator = colDef(
      name = "Indicators",
      minWidth = 220,

      style = list(
        color = "#5544cc",
        fontSize = "0.84rem"
      )
    ),

    Link = colDef(
      name = "Link",
      minWidth = 120,

      cell = function(value) {

        if (
          is.null(value) ||
          length(value) == 0 ||
          is.na(value) ||
          value == ""
        ) {
          return("")
        }

        tags$a(
          href = value,
          target = "_blank",
          rel = "noopener noreferrer",
          "View reference"
        )
      }
    )
  ),

  theme = reactableTheme(
    borderColor = "#dedbea",
    highlightColor = "#f4f2ff",
    cellPadding = "10px 12px",

    style = list(
      fontFamily = "Comfortaa, sans-serif",
      fontSize = "0.86rem"
    ),

    searchInputStyle = list(
      width = "280px",
      border = "1px solid #c9c3e5",
      borderRadius = "8px",
      padding = "9px 12px"
    ),

    selectStyle = list(
      border = "1px solid #c9c3e5",
      borderRadius = "8px",
      padding = "6px"
    ),

    paginationStyle = list(
      marginTop = "18px"
    )
  )
)
```
